data.name: Imagine Wind
data.detailed_description:
You wake beneath the ice of Antarctica - without a name, without a past, and... with a voice in your head.

Before you lies a gigantic subterranean world: forests, valleys, rivers, mountains, and canyons. This place doesn’t rush or shout - it whispers, waiting for you to find a thread and pull it. It seems it has been waiting for you for thousands of years.

Imagine Wind is a first-person atmospheric adventure about exploration, light survival, and a story told by the world itself. Gather resources, create shelter, listen to environmental clues, and study amber artifacts at the research table: activate points, connect hints, open new passages, and uncover fragments of your own memory. This isn’t a race - it’s a journey whose main goal is to figure out who you are.

Key Features

  • Subglacial world. Forests, fields, canyons, rivers, and valleys with hidden paths that tell the stories of those who were here before you.

  • Calm survival. Gather resources, craft what you need, and care for water and food - without unnecessary stress.

  • Building. Set up temporary camps wherever it’s convenient, exactly as much as you need to travel comfortably further.

  • Research table. Experiment with amber, study the forgotten, and unlock memories, recipes, and new routes.

  • Settlements and inhabitants. There are those here you could call people... or not? Learn their stories and decide whom to trust.

  • Exploration without limits. Seek out secrets, ruins, and shortcuts, find evidence of those who did - or did not - make it out.

  • Atmosphere and immersion. A minimalist art style, 3D audio, and a gentle pace that encourages you to look, listen, and discover.

The main mystery isn’t only what this place is. The main mystery is who you are.

And perhaps the answer appears where you learn to... imagine the wind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / 750 Ti, AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB, AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
